extracted.intended_audience: biomedical researchers and bioinformaticians who need to annotate and functionally analyze large gene lists
extracted.subtask_description: Using the DAVID Bioinformatics Resources to perform comprehensive gene annotation, expression data analysis, pathway mapping, and other functional genomics tasks on uploaded gene lists. Focuses on enrichment analysis, identifier conversion, visualization, clustering of terms, and pathway display.

rubrics_metrics.name: Functional interpretation of large gene lists
rubrics_metrics.description: All tools in the DAVID Bioinformatics Resources aim to provide functional interpretation of large lists of genes derived from genomic studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conduct comprehensive gene annotation, expression data analysis, biological pathway mapping, and other functional genomics tasks for uploaded gene lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: DAVID tool-suite composition
rubrics_metrics.description: The updated DAVID Bioinformatics Resources consists of the DAVID Knowledgebase and five integrated, web-based functional annotation tool suites: the DAVID Gene Functional Classification Tool, the DAVID Functional Annotation Tool, the DAVID Gene ID Conversion Tool, the DAVID Gene Name Viewer and the DAVID NIAID Pathogen Genome Browser.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the appropriate integrated tool suite depending on task: classification, annotation, ID conversion, name viewing, or pathogen-genome browsing.

rubrics_metrics.name: DAVID Knowledgebase integration
rubrics_metrics.description: The expanded DAVID Knowledgebase now integrates almost all major and well-known public bioinformatics resources centralized by the DAVID Gene Concept, a single-linkage method to agglomerate tens of millions of diverse gene/protein identifiers and annotation terms from a variety of public bioinformatics databases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rely on the Knowledgebase for extensive cross-referencing of identifiers and annotations drawn from many public resources; the DAVID Gene Concept links equivalent gene/protein entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gene-term enrichment analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: For any uploaded gene list, the DAVID Resources provides the typical gene-term enrichment analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use enrichment analysis to identify terms (e.g., GO terms, pathways) over-represented in the input gene list compared to a background.

rubrics_metrics.name: Condensing large gene lists into functional groups
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID provides tools and functions that allow users to condense large gene lists into gene functional groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the Gene Functional Classification Tool to group genes into biologically meaningful modules to reduce redundancy and simplify interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gene/protein identifier conversion
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID provides a Gene ID Conversion Tool to convert between gene/protein identifiers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convert disparate identifier types (e.g., accession numbers, gene symbols, IDs from different databases) to a common identifier to enable downstream analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visualization of many-genes-to-many-terms relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID allows users to visualize many-genes-to-many-terms relationships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use visualization functions to explore complex relationships between genes and annotation terms, aiding interpretation of many-to-many mappings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clustering redundant and heterogeneous terms
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID can cluster redundant and heterogeneous terms into groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cluster related annotation terms to reduce redundancy and highlight coherent biological themes across the gene list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for related genes or terms
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID provides search functions to find interesting and related genes or terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use search to discover genes or annotation terms related to user-specified queries or to explore connections suggested by enrichment/clustering results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dynamic pathway viewing
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID can dynamically view genes from user lists on bio-pathways.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Map genes onto biological pathway diagrams to visualize their positions and relationships within metabolic or signaling pathways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supported analysis domains and keywords
rubrics_metrics.description: DAVID supports gene annotation, genome annotation, functional annotation, gene expression data analysis, biological pathway analysis, metabolic pathways, signal transduction pathways, gene-disease association analysis, protein-protein interaction analysis, gene functional classification, gene expression profiling, microarray data analysis, and protein domain annotation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select DAVID for a broad range of functional genomics analyses including pathway mapping, disease association exploration, interaction context, and microarray/expression profiling interpretation.
